Rint the Archer

Biography

Rint is a village archer initially bound by his duty to the captain. When he is free to decide for himself, he can accompany Zak. He is confident in his marksmanship, prefers a small travelling party and wishes Zak well when the journey takes him to other lands. [1, 2, 3, 4]
